judged_text: The route default-imports zod (import z from "zod"), but zod's CommonJS entry sets __esModule and exports no default, so z binds to undefined at runtime. z.object(...) on line 9 throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'object') when the route module first loads, so every request to POST /api/webhook/app-credential returns a 500 — the inbound credential-sync webhook never functions at all (every other file in this repo uses import { z } from "zod").

In this diff, every other zod usage shown imports it as a named export (`import { z } from "zod";`, e.g. `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts` and `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`).
